system.roleplaying: There is something you want, and you strive towards achieving your goals, no matter the cost. You see paths to victory that no one else will.
system.minorTwist: How is the pursuit of your goals getting in the way of being a hero in this situation?
system.majorTwist: What did you just pass up or miss that could have helped you achieve your biggest goal at last?

greenAbility.name: Principle of Ambition
greenAbility.gameText: Overcome a situation where someone else has given you a bonus from a Boost and use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
